rule: Translate component by component, not page by page. Every inventoried pattern gets a row decision: map, merge, or drop with a reason.
detect_note: Signals are case-insensitive regular expressions run by tools/survey.py. html signals match raw markup, text signals match visible text, href signals match link targets, script signals match script sources and inline script, css signals match style blocks and linked same-origin stylesheets.
